heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A hydrostatic test on a high pressure steam boiler:

options.A: Will test the high pressure steam fuel cut off
options.B: Must only be done by the inspector
options.C: Must be done according to jurisdictional regulations
options.D: Must be done before every start up of a boiler
options.E: Should be done with the Chief Engineer present

explanation: Hydrostatic testing must strictly comply with jurisdictional regulations and ASME code guidelines governing test pressure, water temperature, and safety precautions.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: One of the legal responsibilities of the engineer during an inspection is:

options.A: To notify the Workers' Compensation Board of the inspection
options.B: To be in possession of an inspection certificate
options.C: To allow the inspector onto the premises, but only during working hours
options.D: Point out any known or suspected defects to the inspector
options.E: To have at least two staff members present at all times

explanation: Power engineering regulations legally obligate the operating engineer or owner to point out any known or suspected defects, cracks, or leaks to the boiler inspector.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: What is the water pressure a boiler is subject to when a hydrostatic test is being carried out?

options.D: 2 times the setting of the lowest set safety valve

explanation: A standard hydrostatic pressure test on a boiler is carried out at 1.5 times (1 1/2 times) the maximum allowable working pressure (MAWP) or lowest safety valve setting.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: When the boiler is removed from service, it can be drained once the temperature reaches approximately:
explanation: When a boiler is removed from service, it should be allowed to cool before draining. The water temperature should reach approximately 90°C before draining. This helps reduce the risk of thermal shock, sudden temperature changes, and damage to boiler components. Remember: Allow the boiler to cool to approximately 90°C before draining.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: An inhibitor, when added to acid will:

options.A: Make the acid compatible with the sewer system for disposal
options.C: Strengthen the acid thereby shortening the cleaning procedure
options.D: Prevent the acid from attacking the boiler metal
options.E: Minimise the effect the acid has on the metal

explanation: Inhibitors are chemical agents added to acid cleaning solutions to minimize or prevent acid attack on the bare parent metal of the boiler while allowing scale dissolution.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A boiler inspection:

options.A: Is done with the owners permission only
options.B: Is only required after a boiler has been operating 3 years
options.C: Must be done whenever the boiler inspector requests it
options.D: Is only required if an accident occurs
options.E: Must be done after every shut down of the boiler

explanation: A boiler inspection is a legal requirement and must be granted whenever requested by an authorized jurisdictional boiler inspector.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: External inspection includes:

options.A: Inspect all auxiliary equipment and pressure vessels
options.B: Check the plant records, log books, etc
options.C: Check the operation of each safety shutdown device

explanation: An external inspection while the boiler is in operation encompasses checking auxiliary equipment, reviewing logbooks, testing safety shutdown devices, and observing overall maintenance practices.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: Just before entering the waterside of the boiler it is important to:

options.A: Obtain permission to do so from plant management
options.B: Ensure the Chief Engineer is aware of your intent
options.C: Notify the inspector in writing of your intent to do so
options.D: Be wearing self-contained breathing apparatus SCBA

explanation: Prior to entering the drum or waterside of a boiler (confined space), atmospheric testing for oxygen levels and toxic/flammable gases is mandatory.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: Before cleaning the waterside and as far as is possible:

options.B: A scale sample should be taken and an analysis done
options.C: All drum internals should be removed
options.D: Mud drum sludge should be completely removed
options.E: A visual inspection of pressure parts should be completed

explanation: Before washing or cleaning away deposits on the waterside, a thorough preliminary visual inspection of internal pressure parts should be completed to document baseline condition and scale buildup.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: The most popular acid for boiler cleaning is:
explanation: Inhibited hydrochloric acid is the most widely used and cost-effective acid for chemical cleaning of industrial boilers.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: Chemical cleaning of smaller boilers is not usually done because:

options.A: They do not have adequate support for the high density of the chemicals
options.B: Of the small surface area which the chemical contacts
options.C: It is impossible to get the chemical circulating adequately
options.D: Of the thin metal of which they are manufactured
options.E: The cost to do so is not warranted or justified

explanation: Chemical cleaning requires specialized pumps, piping, neutralizing steps, and chemical disposal; for smaller boilers, the financial cost is rarely justified compared to mechanical cleaning.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: The recommended procedures for a boiler inspection are stated in the:

options.A: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section I
options.C: CSA B51 Boiler Pressure Vessel and Pressure Piping Code
options.D: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section VII
options.E: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section IV

explanation: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section VII provides recommended guidelines and procedures for the care, maintenance, and inspection of power boilers.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A relatively safer chemical used in boiler cleaning and treatment is:
explanation: Chelates (chelating agents like EDTA and NTA) are relatively safe, less corrosive organic chemicals used for continuous or periodic cleaning and scale removal compared to mineral acids.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: For an alkaline boil out, the boiler is maintained at a desired steam pressure for about:
explanation: During an alkaline boil-out, the boiler is filled with water containing alkaline cleaning chemicals, such as caustic soda and trisodium phosphate. The boiler is heated and maintained at the required steam pressure for approximately 48 hours. This allows the chemicals enough time to loosen and remove oil, grease, and other manufacturing residues from the boiler's internal surfaces. Remember: Alkaline boil-out = 48 hours (2 days).

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: When cooling down a steam boiler that has been taken out of service, a vent valve on the steam drum should be opened to prevent a vacuum at:
explanation: When cooling a boiler, the drum vent valve is opened when pressure drops to approximately 175 kPa (or 15-20 psi) to prevent creating a atmospheric vacuum inside the vessel.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: The external inspection of a boiler:

options.A: May include making sure the furnace refractory is in order
options.B: May include making sure the exterior of the tubes are in good condition
options.C: Must be done after the boiler has been drained
options.D: May include making sure the tubes are free of scale
options.E: May include making sure the valves are in good operating condition

explanation: An external inspection is conducted while the boiler is operating and includes checking the external condition and operational readiness of valves, controls, and fittings.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A boiler has been in operation for one year and is now taken off the line for cleaning, repair and inspection. The boiler is one of three in a battery and the other two will remain in operation. This one boiler is to be drained and cooled. Before any person is allowed to enter the boiler drum, the correct safety procedure requires that the:

options.A: Main steam, blow down, blow off, and feedwater valves be closed, chained and tagged
options.B: Person is equipped with the correct kind of tools and a list of required repairs
options.C: Worker is provided with a safety kit for confined space entry
options.D: Worker is provided with a safety line, first aid kit, and hard hat
options.E: Drum be vented, the safety valve gagged, and all ashes and soot removed from the fire box

explanation: When a boiler is part of a battery with common headers, all connected steam, blowdown, and feedwater isolation valves must be securely closed, locked/chained, and tagged out (and preferably blanked) before drum entry.

heading: Boiler Cleaning
question: A hydrostatic test should be applied to a boiler:

options.A: At the request of the owner
options.C: At the request of the boiler inspector

explanation: A hydrostatic test is performed after major pressure component repairs or whenever explicitly requested by the authorized boiler inspector.
